units.source_text: 此时那僧都从那边走来了，对尼姑说：“在这屋里，外边都窥得见。

en.t: Just then the bishop came over from the other side and said to the nun, "In this room, people outside can see right in.

units.source_text: 今天你为什么偏偏坐在这里呢？

en.t: Why did you choose to sit here today of all places?

units.source_text: 我告诉你：山上老和尚那里，源氏中将来祈病了，我此刻才得知呢。

en.t: Let me tell you: Genji the Lieutenant General has come to the old monk up the mountain to pray for recovery from illness, and I have only just learned of it.

units.source_text: 他此行非常秘密，我全不知道。

en.t: His visit was kept very secret, and I knew nothing about it at all.

units.source_text: 我住在这里，却不曾过去请安。”

en.t: Though I live here, I have not yet gone over to pay my respects."

units.source_text: 尼姑说：“呀，怎么好呢！

en.t: The nun said, "Oh, what are we to do!

units.source_text: 我们这种简陋的模样，恐怕已被他的随从窥见了！”

en.t: I am afraid his attendants have already caught sight of us looking so shabby!"

units.source_text: 便把帘子放下。

en.t: She then lowered the blind.

units.source_text: 但闻僧都说：“这位天下闻名的光源氏，你想拜见一下么？

en.t: Then they heard the bishop say, "Would you like to have a glimpse of this world-famous shining Genji?

units.source_text: 风采真美丽啊！

en.t: His grace and bearing are truly beautiful!

units.source_text: 像我这样看破了红尘的和尚，拜见之下也觉得世虑皆忘，却病延年呢。

en.t: Even a monk like me, who has seen through the dust of the world, feels worldly cares vanish when I behold him, as if illness were held off and life prolonged.

units.source_text: 好，让我送个信去吧。”

en.t: Very well, let me send a message."

units.source_text: 便听见他的脚步声。

en.t: Then his footsteps could be heard.

units.source_text: 源氏公子深恐被他看见，连忙回寺。

en.t: Lord Genji, greatly afraid of being seen by him, hurried back to the temple.

units.source_text: 他心中想：“今天看到了可爱的人儿了。

en.t: He thought to himself, "Today I have seen a lovely little person.

units.source_text: 世间有这等奇遇，怪不得那些好色之徒要东钻西钻，去找寻意想不到的美人。

en.t: If such strange encounters exist in the world, it is no wonder those amorous men go poking here and there in search of unexpected beauties.

units.source_text: 像我这样难得出门的人，也会碰到这种意外之事。”

en.t: Even someone like me, who rarely goes out, can meet with such an unforeseen thing."

units.source_text: 他对此事颇感兴趣。

en.t: He was quite intrigued by the matter.

units.source_text: 继而又想：“那个女孩相貌实在俊美。

en.t: Then he thought again, "That girl's looks are truly beautiful.

units.source_text: 不知道是何等样人。

en.t: I wonder what sort of person she is.

units.source_text: 我很想要她来住在身边，代替了那个人[\[8\]](#part1334.html#m8)，朝朝夜夜看着她，求得安慰。”

en.t: I would very much like to have her live by my side, in place of that person[\[8\]](#part1334.html#m8), and look at her morning and night to find comfort."

units.source_text: 这念头很深切。

en.t: This thought took deep hold of him.
